newsitem.title: USA: Dow climbs to its third record close in a row.
newsitem.headline: Dow climbs to its third record close in a row.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average set its third straight record close Thursday after a fast-paced recovery from a bout of profit taking.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 28.57 points at a new high of 8,116.93, which surpassed Wednesday's milestone of 8,088.38. Early in the day, the index plunged more than 90 points.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on moderate volume of 575 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
